findings: cilindros constant-radius connected bands and two caps; size change also changes length; source cap orientation is not outward at both ends.

fieeee connects nonconstant adjacent ring radii; global draw calls do not establish the note's offscreen-flattening claim; one random fill per band, and resolution changes both dimensions and colour draw count.
prueba4 strips overlap by construction, not contiguous axial bands.
cityPink3d adjacent vertical bands have different radii without connecting faces.

aros has inner and outer walls plus radial faces at EVERY subdivision level; after h*=0.5 its h/sub step traverses -h to zero, not -h to +h. Interior horizontal faces duplicate at adjacent levels; inner and outer walls have identical angular winding. This is not a demonstrated clean manifold annulus contract.
Circo builds a constant-radius open surface over positive cumulative band heights; its base face winding faces inward. Appearance overlay and random band construction are separate from connectivity.
